classification.source: unchanged ORE2015 corpus used for v1.4.4
classification.scope: full corpus, including invalid-input and unsupported-profile outcomes

incremental.selection: 20 domain-separated SHA-256 ranks per original byte-size band: <100KiB, <1MiB, <10MiB, >=10MiB, among 1708 validated inputs; maximum80
modes: retained session where supported, recording actual reuse or rebuild
fresh rebuild for every revision and every reasoner
incremental.correctness: each revision against fresh same-reasoner output and independent reference; inconsistent ontologies compare consistency only, unsatisfiable sets checked separately

justification.query_selection: lowest domain-separated hash ranks of non-reflexive named subclass entailments from a pinned HermiT reference taxonomy, excluding builtin classes, unsatisfiable subclasses and explicitly asserted SubClassOf pairs; fewer if unavailable
justification.reference_failure: retain query-preparation failure as a visible outcome, never substitute an easier ontology
justification.query_modules: freeze source-bound STAR modules once per query for all reasoners; report preparation cost and source/module sizes
justification.target: one source-axiom subset-minimal justification per query
justification.methods: native API where available; explicitly labelled common black-box source-deletion adapter otherwise
justification.validation: different reasoner confirms source membership, entailment and failure of entailment after each single-axiom deletion; validation time separate from generation

reporting: all cases and failures, including profile-limited and invalid-input rows
input and artifact hashes, commands, actual limits, raw outputs and receipts
paired common-success timing and memory summaries alongside coverage, never success-only rankings
update reuse strategies and cold-versus-retained costs
justification sizes, oracle calls when available, generation cost and independent correctness
release_gate: complete workloads, adjudicated correctness, reproducible records, exact-tagged-source Lean certification, published v1.4.5
